unit: Institute for Data, Systems, and Society (IDSS)
notes: IDSS's people page categorizes Core Faculty, Affiliate Faculty, Visiting Faculty, Senior Research Staff and Research Staff, but is built as a non-tabular WordPress/ACF block layout that did not yield a clean per-person list in this pass (unlike IMES/EAPS/EECS, which use a consistent repeating card template). IDSS core faculty are also predominantly joint-appointed with EECS, LIDS, Sloan or Civil & Environmental Engineering (e.g. Munther Dahleh, Devavrat Shah, Asu Ozdaglar) and would likely duplicate those departments' own source files. Recorded empty for now; worth a dedicated re-fetch/parse pass later given IDSS's priority-1 status.
